proposal.hazard: Open-loop gripping in TASK2/Module1.mod (lines 104-118) and TASK1/Module1.mod (lines 115-156): the legacy code issues PulseDO DO_SG_P, waits 0.25s, and proceeds to the place trajectory without checking gripper position or sensor feedback, causing missed grasps (13 of 19 failures) to go completely undetected.

proposal.meaning: HIGH (1) when the gripper fingers reach the fully closed end-stop (stroke > 0.85), indicating the jaws closed on empty air rather than stalling on a block (~0.52).
proposal.hardware: A magnetic reed switch or inductive proximity sensor mounted on the pneumatic/electric gripper cylinder at the full-closure end-stop, wired to the GoFa's available 24V Digital Input (either via the OmniCore controller I/O or the GoFa tool flange I/O).
proposal.rapid_usage: After pulsing DO_SG_P and waiting 0.25s, check IF DI_GripperClosedOnNothing = 1 (or WaitDI for part presence with a timeout) to trigger a retry/re-grasp routine or raise an alarm before pulsing DO_ATT_TTAB and executing the place move.

telemetry_rule.description: Flag a missed grasp when the gripper is commanded to close (action.gripper_position >= 0.80) and the measured finger position (observation.gripper_position) closes past 0.85, whereas a successful grasp on the block stalls around 0.52.

cited_evidence.what: Gripper closes to 0.94 on empty air above the green block at (0.611, 0.280, 0.164); caught because 0.94 >= 0.85.
Gripper closes to 0.97 at z=0.192 while lifting away from the block; caught because 0.97 >= 0.85.
Gripper closes to 0.96 at (0.497, 0.219, 0.138) as block slips/is missed; caught because 0.96 >= 0.85.
First closure reaches 0.88 (missed grasp, caught because 0.88 >= 0.85), contrasting with the successful re-grasp at t=253.13s where gripper stalls on the block at 0.52 (< 0.85).

proposal.expected_effect: Eliminates silent dry-cycles by catching all 13 missed-grasp episodes (68% of all observed cell failures) immediately at the pick location, enabling automatic re-grasp (as demonstrated manually in seg 46) instead of executing empty place trajectories.

approval.note: proposed hardware addition; simulated in the twin as 1 while the gripper holds a part
